journey.name: connection recovery during required wallet restore
journey.description: Use a disposable dev wallet and a controlled recovery fixture with an acknowledged complete wallet backup. Prepare a failing Electrum endpoint and a reachable replacement, plus a backup SETTINGS record containing the old endpoint. Required WALLET and USDT recovery must remain pending until their imports succeed. Never reset an existing wallet or use live funds. iOS restores required backup state before starting a rebuilt node; Android can need a running node during restoration. The iOS editor validates Electrum syntax on Save; permitted startup proves connectivity. RGS uses an independent endpoint probe. Installed simulator checks cover authenticated restoration, correction persistence, retry and restart, required-marker/local-storage failures, and optional profile failure/recovery. The fixture's successful empty USDT record listing is not a nonempty USDT import or proof of full chain synchronization or spending. Actual wallet wipe remains unrun and outside the no-reset authorization. Component tests are separate from these app checks.

actions.action: Restore the fixture wallet and verify failed node startup offers Connection Settings without access to ordinary wallet actions
Open Connection Settings and verify the screen tagged WalletConnectionRecovery is visible without Proceed Without Backup
Enter the reachable Electrum endpoint in RecoveryElectrumInput and tap RecoveryElectrumSave; verify RecoverySaved appears without automatically retrying restoration
Change and save RGS independently; verify a failed probe shows RecoveryError and retains the last acknowledged correction
Return to the restore error and tap Try Again; verify required wallet restoration resumes with the saved correction before a rebuilt node starts
Keep required recovery unavailable and restart the app; verify the correction is retained and spending remains gated

While required recovery remains unavailable, background and foreground three times and tap Try Again; verify the correction and gates remain and no already-running node is rebuilt solely because the unchanged correction is retained
Allow restoration of the old SETTINGS backup; verify only the explicitly corrected endpoints override that backup and unrelated preferences restore normally
Complete required WALLET and USDT recovery; verify ordinary wallet actions become available only after both acknowledgements
Repeat with only optional profile caching unavailable after required recovery; verify that error retains its optional recovery controls and is not classified as failed node startup

On a separate empty test installation, go offline before tapping New Wallet; verify creation stays in initialization without Spending balance error or Connection Settings. Restore connectivity and verify startup resumes through the ordinary coordinator without bypassing any required recovery marker
